propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls that silently truncate at 50 issues, causing projects with more than 50 issues to have incomplete or missing data
the search_issues method defaults to max_results=50 without pagination, so issues beyond the first page are never fetched and appear as spurious link-creation mutations or missing comments

a shared _paged_search helper must be extracted and used by get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map, and get_parent_map to implement safe pagination that advances by actual batch length and terminates only on empty pages
Jira DC silently truncates maxResults above the configured maximum, so short pages must not be treated as proof of exhaustion; the pager must drive off returned row counts rather than requested size
regression tests must verify that all three methods recover complete data from projects exceeding the default page size, with payload content assertions not just key counts
